==About==

A {{i|Boiled Yellow Morel}} is made by boiling a {{i|Yellow Morel}} in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}}. With the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, a Boiled Yellow Morel can still be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Waning Toadstool. When planting a Boiled Yellow Morel there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]].Both a Boiled Yellow Morel and a Yellow Morel count as a Yellow Morel when planting and in Food recipes. '''NOTE:''' There is a chance that even after boiling, a Yellow Morel will still be poisonous.
